footer_reason: You received this email because you created a Catequese Viva account.
unsubscribe: I don't want these emails anymore
unsubscribed_body: You will no longer receive account follow-up emails from Catequese Viva.
unsubscribe_invalid_body: This unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Catequese Viva, {{name}}
welcome.heading: Your catechesis starts here
welcome.body: Hi, {{name}}. Your account is ready. Create the first class to take attendance and prepare meetings in one place.

family.subject: Invitation to the Family Portal — {{location}}
family.heading: You were invited to the Family Portal
family.body:
You were invited to the Family Portal of "{{location}}" as {{role}}.

In this portal you follow your family's catechesis (meetings, attendance, and documents).

To accept, open: {{link}}

This invitation expires in 30 days.

staff.subject: Invitation to the catechesis team — {{location}}
staff.heading: Invitation to the catechesis team
staff.body:
You were invited to join the catechesis team of "{{location}}" as {{role}}.

This access is for the pastoral dashboard (coordinators and catechists), not the Family Portal.

To accept, open: {{link}}

This invitation expires in 30 days.

support_reply.subject: Support reply — Catequese Viva
support_reply.heading: Support reply
support_reply.intro: We received your message. Our reply is:
support_reply.outro: You can also see this reply in the Catequese Viva support inbox.

canceled.subject: Your subscription will end
canceled.heading: Access continues until the paid period ends
canceled.body: Hi, {{name}}. We received your cancellation. You keep access until the end of the period already paid. If you changed your mind, reactivate in Billing.

payment_failed.subject: We could not process your payment
payment_failed.heading: Subscription payment failed
payment_failed.body: Hi, {{name}}. Update your payment method so you don't lose access to catechesis.

institutional_trial_d3.subject: 3 days left on the parish trial
institutional_trial_d3.heading: 3 days left on the parish trial
institutional_trial_d3.body: Hi, {{name}}. The trial for {{parishName}} ends in 3 days. Open Billing to continue.

institutional_trial_d1.subject: The parish trial ends tomorrow
institutional_trial_d1.heading: The parish trial ends tomorrow
institutional_trial_d1.body: Hi, {{name}}. The trial for {{parishName}} ends tomorrow. Open Billing to continue.

preferences.title: Email preferences
preferences.lifecycle: Activation tips, trial, and win-back emails
preferences.transactional_note: Login, invite, and billing emails cannot be turned off.

broadcast.footer: You receive this email because you subscribed to Catequese Viva updates.

activate_create_class.subject: Create your first class on Catequese Viva
activate_create_class.heading: Your catechesis is still on paper
activate_create_class.body: Hi, {{name}}. Create the class in about 2 minutes to start attendance and meetings in one place.

activate_add_people.subject: Add catechumens to {{className}}
activate_add_people.heading: {{className}} is empty
activate_add_people.body: Hi, {{name}}. Without names, you can't take attendance or message families.

activate_first_action.subject: Sunday comes fast — record attendance
activate_first_action.heading: The first meeting or roll call is still missing
activate_first_action.body: Hi, {{name}}. Record attendance or prepare the first meeting for {{className}}.

convert_after_value.subject: Your class is live — keep access
convert_after_value.heading: Attendance and meetings are already on Catequese Viva
convert_after_value.body: Hi, {{name}}. Subscribe to the Catechist Plan ({{price}}/month) so you don't lose access on {{trialEndsAt}}.

trial_d3.subject: 3 days left on your trial
trial_d3.heading: You have 3 days left
trial_d3.body_no_class: Hi, {{name}}. There is still time to create the class before the trial ends. It takes about 2 minutes.
trial_d3.body_no_people: Hi, {{name}}. {{className}} still has no catechumens. Add the list so you can take attendance.
trial_d3.body_no_action: Hi, {{name}}. Record the first attendance or create the first meeting for {{className}}.
trial_d3.body_value: Hi, {{name}}. Your class is already live. Subscribe to the Catechist Plan ({{price}}/month) so you don't lose access on {{trialEndsAt}}.

trial_d1.subject: Your trial ends tomorrow
trial_d1.heading: The trial period ends tomorrow
trial_d1.body_no_class: Hi, {{name}}. There is still time to create the class today and see Catequese Viva in action.
trial_d1.body_no_people: Hi, {{name}}. Add the catechumens for {{className}} today — the trial ends tomorrow.
trial_d1.body_no_action: Hi, {{name}}. Record attendance or prepare the meeting for {{className}} before the trial ends tomorrow.
trial_d1.body_value: Hi, {{name}}. The trial ends tomorrow. Subscribe to the Catechist Plan ({{price}}/month) to keep class, attendance, and meetings.

winback_d1.subject: Your class is still saved
winback_d1.heading: The trial ended, but your data did not
winback_d1.body: Hi, {{name}}. Reactivate the Catechist Plan ({{price}}/month) to take attendance and prepare meetings again.

winback_d3.subject: Your catechesis is still here
winback_d3.heading: Three days without access to the class
winback_d3.body: Hi, {{name}}. {{className}} is still saved. Reactivate the Catechist Plan ({{price}}/month) whenever you want to resume attendance.

winback_d7.subject: An invitation to resume catechesis
winback_d7.heading: Your class is waiting
winback_d7.body: Hi, {{name}}. It's been a week since the trial ended. The Catechist Plan is {{price}}/month — reactivate to pick up where you left off.
